headline: Copper Drops to Four-Month Low as US Midterm Shift Sparks Investor Jitters
summary: Copper prices fell to a four-month low as market euphoria following the Democratic midterm election victory in the US gave way to investor nervousness and risk aversion.
why: Copper is a vital industrial metal and a bellwether for global economic health, with price fluctuations directly impacting mining-heavy emerging economies like Peru and Chile.

impacts.name: Copper
impacts.why: Investor nervousness and changing macroeconomic sentiment reduce demand expectations for industrial metals.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Shifting political expectations in the US and growing investor caution caused industrial metals to sell off, driving copper to a four-month low.
